1.note: The words are in 2 Samuel 1:16. Kept as printed.

2.note: Printed so; גם is unclear in sense; rendered 'through use as a common thing'.

3.note: The stubborn and rebellious son is in Mishnah Sanhedrin ch. 8. Kept as printed.

4.he: וכל פרטי דיני ההתראה וההתרה למיתה, אבל
4.note: The Hebrew clause has no verb of its own; rendered as part of what came 'from this root'.

5.note: The verses quoted are Psalm 24:3-4; the print has 25.

6.note: Genesis 25:14 has no promise to the patriarchs; Genesis 28:14 is meant. Kept as printed.

7.note: The verse reads 'upon thee' (עליך); Weiss has 'upon them'.

9.note: 'And all Edom became servants to him' is 2 Samuel 8:14.

10.he: (דה"י א' ק"ו כ"ג- ל"ד, תהלים צ"ו. צ"ו)
10.note: Printed ק"ו; 1 Chronicles 16:23-34 is meant. The second psalm number repeats צ"ו; perhaps ק"ו (Psalm 106:1 = 1 Chr 16:34).

11.note: The verse is 1 Kings 8:60; print has ט'.

12.note: מלאכות is unclear here; read as 'the task/mission of Israel'.

13.note: אותיות ('letters') makes no sense; read as עתות ('times'), likely a misprint.

14.he: והרבה אותם והכבידם והיו בניו כקדם ועדתם לפניו תכון ופקד על לוחציהם (שם ל"א)
14.note: These words are Jeremiah 30:19–20, not chapter 31; reference kept as printed.

15.note: The words 'the sure mercies of David' are Isaiah 55:3; the print has 56:3. Kept as printed.

16.note: The quoted words are Ezra 1:2; the print has 1:3. Kept as printed.

17.note: The word סרה is in Isaiah 1:5; the figure may be ה rather than ח. Kept as read.

18.note: Print unclear between מונה and מונח; read מונח.

19.note: Figures unclear in print; the words are in 1 Chronicles 22:8 (cf. 28:3).

20.note: The passage is 2 Chronicles 7:8-10; print has א'.

22.note: 1 Chronicles 21 has 30 verses; 'the house of the Lord God' is at 22:1.

23.note: Name unclear in print; taken as De Wette.
